>> Across the earth, the prophets moves.
From city streets to distant lands. The
message is the same.
Israel must rise. Through every quest,
every journey, the truth spreads.
No border can contain it. No distance
can silence it. Our nation lives in
every moment. In joy, we
celebrate marriages. In sorrow, we honor
our dead. On the Sabbath, we gather as
one. Families rejoicing together, bound
by the commandments of God. Yet are we
tried. From the stones in Kenya to the
hatred in Montana, we endure as a
soldier of the Lord.
And still the mission expands  on
the airwaves, on the screens, in every
nation under heaven. Israel's voices
heard.
We build our communities. We
raise our children in royalty.
We restore what was broken. We clean
what was defiled.
We show the world who we are.
This is Israel United Christ. Nation in
motion. Nation endures.
